justification: A evidência mostra que o EU AI Act utiliza 'general-purpose AI model' como categoria legal operativa (Capítulo V, definições), sem mencionar 'foundation model'. O Artigo 53 impõe obrigações horizontais aos provedores de general-purpose AI models (documentação técnica, transparência, direitos autorais), independentemente de uso downstream em aplicações de alto risco. A definição do modelo indica que ele 'can be integrated into a variety of downstream systems or applications', e as obrigações do Artigo 53 aplicam-se ao provedor do modelo em si, sem condicionamento ao uso em sistemas high-risk.

CHAPTER V
GENERAL-PURPOSE AI MODELS

Classification rules

Article 51

Classification of general-purpose AI models as general-purpose AI models with systemic risk

A general-purpose AI model shall be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it meets any of the following conditions:

it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks;

based on a decision of the Commission, ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel, it has capabilities or an impact equivalent to those set out in point (a) having regard to the criteria set out in Annex XIII.

Article 52

Procedure

The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 in order to amend Annex XIII by specifying and updating the criteria set out in that Annex.
